rawContent: Golden Globes: OMG! Oprah you killed it!!! I'm so very inspired by your strong words  and examples. Thank you for speaking out especially for those who don’t  have help/support/a platform. Thank you!  I'm still fighting (for yrs).  BUT I'm still fighting. #MeToo

...AND Blick Lives Matter! Continuously throughout history-though often overlooked/ignored--Black women have & still face DAILY horrific injustices & malicious treatment ESPECIALLY Black girls & Black women who are unable to afford proper & effective legal representation. #MeToo https://t.co/otElgsNMU7

EXACTLY! But not just speak on it.... DO SOMETHING POSITIVE & MEANINGFUL!!! Males who claim they don't know what to do ASK WOMEN then intently listen & do the right thing consistently & positively. Stop thinking men own women! You "partner" w/women not own us. #TimesUpNOW  #MeToo https://t.co/B1qgppDMCH
@dmcguire13 @arishapiro @NPR @MichelleObama @Oprah @goldenglobes This shot had me emotional before I even read the caption. What we see in each others eyes.  #MeToo

@Oprah Your Times Up Now speech at the Golden Globes brought me to my feet in front of the tv, bought praises to our ancestors and our community, and blew minds all over the world. Thank you also for not forgetting military women . #TimesUpNow  #MeToo

@dmcguire13 @UWMadison Thank you for sharing Danielle. I find strength in that. I'm still fighting & lately allowing myself to reach out a little more. There are still way too many limitations & not enough resources but I'm glad for the progress. #MeToo  #Hope

I read that the MeToo Movement is going to the military corps. It's about time! Remembering Lavena Johnson & so many other women military vets dead & living. Remembering, praying & pressing for those STILL suffering & dealing w/the aftermath & severe system of retaliation. #MeToo

@LoniLove Hi Loni. Have you & your radio crew ever thought about doing a forum with non-Hollywood, everyday, Black women dealing w/& fighting sexual harassment & assault issues? Also invite attorneys who will take cases. #TimesUp #MeToo
@O_Magazine Oprah Thank you for not forgetting to mention women military veterans in your speech. Seems like they keep getting forgotten/left out by others.  #MeToo #TimesUp
@Oprah Oprah Thank you for not forgetting to mention women military veterans in  your speech. Seems like they keep getting forgotten/left out by  others. #MeToo #TimesUp
@usblm I really like the that Max & Nev from Catfish proudly where Black Lives Matter shirts for the world to see. #BlackLivesMatter #BLMEverwhere
@ananavarro PLEASE don't forget about women military veterans. We don’t have the  resources and supports. Lots of relentless bullying, retaliation, and  suffering.  #MeToo #UsToo
@ValerieJarrett PLEASE don't forget about women military veterans. We don’t have the  resources and supports. Lots of relentless bullying, retaliation, and  suffering.  #MeToo #UsToo

@TaranaBurke Hence the NEED for consistent & continuous pliable education, enforcing of rules & laws, & applying appropriate consequences accordingly. Clearly this should be applicable for both sides.  RT... #MeToo #NoBlurredLines
